Andrew's back -- I don't have any bigger picture

Matt -- that last bug was almost certainly my
bad!). I finished the doc and revised the home

I have an early lunch meeting down here, but
will be up at Columbia by 1 PM or so.

Mitzi goes into the hospital tomorrow (Thursday),
so I'll be out Thu and Fri, and hopefully back
on Monday, but no promises.

- Bob
